name: Venom Dart
description: Flick a bead of venom qi from the fingertips that stings a target's skin from a few paces away.

name: Toxin Film
description: Coat the forearms in a thin film of toxin qi so a gripping hand comes away numb.

name: Gall Touch
description: Press a palm of bitter qi on the target's arm to leave a burning numbness that spreads slowly.

name: Bitter Taste
description: Let the tongue and nose pick out the bitter note of poison in food and drink close by.

name: Fang Prick
description: Narrow two fingers into a fang and prick a gap in cloth or leather to inject venom qi.

name: Oil Slide
description: Slide sideways on joints loosened with slick toxin qi so a grasping hand closes on empty air.

name: Numbing Mist
description: Breathe out a faint haze of numbing qi that dulls the feeling in a foe's face and hands.

name: Drowse Sting
description: Sting the side of the neck with a drop of drowsing qi so the foe's eyelids droop and the guard sags.

name: Sap Grip
description: Grip a wrist with sticky toxin qi that glues the skin and slows the whole arm for a few breaths.

name: Skin Ward
description: Thin out any weak poison lying on the skin before it can soak in and take hold.

name: Slow Lash
description: Whip a cord of toxin qi across the shin so the leg stiffens and the pace falters.

name: Oily Parry
description: Wipe the forearm with slick toxin qi across an incoming blow so it slides off to the side.

name: Laced Blood
description: Lace the user's own blood with a trace of venom qi so the next few strikes carry a faint sting.

name: Gall Store
description: Bank a small gall of toxin qi in the gut to feed later strikes without drawing on the reserve.

name: Bile Spit
description: Spit a mouthful of caustic bile qi into a foe's eyes from arm's length.

name: Iron Gut
description: Harden the stomach against swallowed poison so spoiled food and tainted drink pass without harm.

name: Gall Jab
description: Drive a knuckle into the ribs with a burst of bitter qi that leaves a lingering ache.

name: Sour Veil
description: Fan a sour haze before the foe's face so the eyes water and the aim wanders.

name: Nettle Slap
description: Slap the foe's cheek or wrist with nettle qi that raises a hot welt at once.

name: Wasp Jab
description: Stab two stiffened fingers at a gap in the guard and release a burst of stinging qi inside.

name: Sting Block
description: Strike the incoming wrist with a stinging palm so the attacker jerks the arm aside.

name: Hornet Hop
description: Hop sideways in short quick jumps on a thread of toxin qi to stay off the foe's line.

name: Welt Mark
description: Raise a painful welt over a pressure point so the foe's next movement hitches.

name: Prickle Read
description: Feel the tingle of toxin qi on bare skin to tell when a foe's hand carries poison.

name: Nightshade Dart
description: Roll a seed of nightshade qi off the thumb to strike a mark a few paces away.

name: Hemlock Touch
description: Brush the target with hemlock qi that creeps up the limb and stiffens the muscle.

name: Aconite Edge
description: Coat the edge of the hand with aconite qi and chop through a gap in the guard.

name: Foxglove Beat
description: Thump the chest with foxglove qi to make the foe's pulse stumble and the breath catch.

name: Wolfsbane Ring
description: Wreath the arms in a ring of wolfsbane qi that stings any hand reaching through.

name: Belladonna Gaze
description: Meet the foe's eyes with a flick of belladonna qi that widens the pupils and blurs sight.

name: Henbane Sway
description: Breathe henbane qi over the foe so the limbs turn heavy and the head swims.

name: Root Sense
description: Taste and smell the bitter plant poisons carried on the wind or hidden in a cup.

name: Creeping Dose
description: Press a fingertip to the foe and leave a seed of toxin that gnaws for many breaths.

name: Gradual Seep
description: Let toxin qi seep into a held limb until it grows heavy and slow to answer.

name: Patient Shell
description: Wrap the body in a shell of aged toxin that sours the strength of any blow landing on it.

name: Drip Reading
description: Read the pace of a poison already in a body by the beat of the pulse at the wrist.

name: Thin Bead
description: Shoot a thin bead of slow toxin that lodges in a foe's skin and works for many breaths.

name: Antidote Draw
description: Draw a foe's thin poison out of the skin with a pulling qi before it spreads.

name: Salve Palm
description: Lay a palm of warm salve qi on an ally's sting or scrape to ease the swelling and the pain.

name: Dose Count
description: Judge the strength of a poison in a cup or a wound by the taste of a single dab.

name: Tonic Pulse
description: Pulse a mild tonic of qi into an ally's blood to steady them against weak toxins.

name: Counter Dart
description: Throw a bead of opposing qi at a poisoned blade tip to dull its edge and fade its coating.

name: Rinse Flow
description: Rinse an ally's wound with cool qi that washes out grit and the first creep of poison.

name: Pale Poultice
description: Press a poultice of pale qi to a bite to slow the swelling and settle the ally's breathing.

name: Barb Fling
description: Fling thorns of hardened toxin qi from the fingers across a short gap.

name: Spore Puff
description: Puff a cloud of spore qi that stings the nose and sets the foe coughing.

name: Moss Cloak
description: Grow a cloak of damp moss qi that soaks up blows and releases a sour spray when struck.

name: Lichen Bind
description: Spread lichen qi over a held wrist so the skin clamps and the arm cannot pull free.

name: Burr Skip
description: Skip away like a burr thrown off a coat, leaving a prickly sting where the foe grabbed.

name: Spore Sense
description: Let fine spore threads drift out to feel living bodies and poison in the nearby air.
